items.source:
Executes all request destruction callbacks and updates the
session attributes that have been accessed during request processing.
items.translation: 执行所有请求销毁回调，并更新在请求处理期间已访问的会话属性。

items.source: Map from attribute name String to destruction callback Runnable.
items.translation: 从属性名称 String 到销毁回调 Runnable 的映射。

items.source: Determine whether the original request is still active.
items.translation: 确定原始请求是否仍然有效。

items.source: Register the given callback as to be executed after request completion.
items.translation: 将给定的回调注册为在请求完成后执行。

items.source: Remove the request destruction callback for the specified attribute, if any.
items.translation: 如果存在，移除指定属性的请求销毁回调。

items.source:
Update all session attributes that have been accessed during request processing,
to expose their potentially updated state to the underlying session manager.
items.translation: 更新在请求处理期间已访问的所有会话属性，以向底层会话管理器暴露其可能更新的当前状态。

items.source: callback - the callback to be executed for destruction
items.translation: callback - 用于销毁时执行的回调

items.source: name - the name of the attribute to remove the callback for
items.translation: name - 要移除回调的属性名称

items.source:
Abstract support class for RequestAttributes implementations,
offering a request completion mechanism for request-specific destruction
callbacks and for updating accessed session attributes.
items.translation: RequestAttributes 实现的抽象支持类，提供用于请求特定销毁回调和更新已访问会话属性的请求完成机制。

items.source: Signal that the request has been completed.
name - the name of the attribute to register the callback for
items.translation: name - 要注册回调的属性的名称
